quotes.name: Ricky C.
quotes.text: Captain Chad with Reel Deal Fishing Charters is absolutely top-notch! He was friendly, knowledgeable, and worked hard to make sure everyone had a great time and stayed on fish. Whether you're an experienced fisherman or taking your family out for a fun day on the water, Captain Chad makes the trip enjoyable from start to finish. We had an incredible time making memories and catching fish. You can tell Captain Chad truly loves what he does and goes above and beyond for his customers.

quotes.name: Darla M.
quotes.text: Our experience with Chad was amazing! Our family of 5 (ranging from 8yrs old to 53 years old) had a wonderful experience! He was especially great with my 8yr old….extremely patient and kind! We caught all kinds of fish and were able to see lots of birds and dolphins! I can't say enough about him and our experience. This excursion will definitely become an annual fishing trip!

quotes.name: Chaland L.
quotes.text: Captain Chad was excellent! Very friendly and knowledgeable. We had a group of 5 and he was very efficient with getting everyone bait. He also had enough rods to keep us going when lines snapped due to getting snagged up! Definitely recommend!

quotes.name: Todd B.
quotes.text: My father and I went out with Chad and had a excellent fishing trip. I recommend Chad. He is very knowledgeable and knows where to go and how to put the fish in the boat. Thanks Chad for an excellent day.

quotes.name: David N.
quotes.text: Had a blast with capt Chad we got are 3 man limit of sheep head. Highly recommend well continue to come back

quotes.name: Erin D.
quotes.text: Took us right to them. 1 away from limit. Thanks Capt Chad.

quotes.name: Sydney H.
quotes.text: I was treated with great care and had so much fun! I felt safe and had a blast!

quotes.name: Lana H.
quotes.text: What an incredible experience! Chad made the whole trip fun, exciting, and unforgettable. From the moment we left the dock to the last fish of the day, everyone had an amazing time. The shark action was nonstop, and the memories we made will last a lifetime. If you're in the area and looking for a great day on the water, I can't recommend Chad and Reel Deal Fishin' Charters enough!

quotes.name: Sydney H.
quotes.text: We had so much fun shark fishing! Chad was so accommodating and helped some of us who had never touched a fishing pole before get a couple of fish haha! 10/10 recommend!!

quotes.name: Ellen M.
quotes.text: Captain Chad was absolutely amazing! We caught a bunch of fish and 3 sharks! It was so much fun, definitely would do this again with Captain Chad!

quotes.name: Keith M.
quotes.text: I booked a trip with Chad told him I had 3 boys 8,10 and 15. He was great and patient with them helping with bait and tangles. He put us on the fish quickly. He asked them if they would like to Shark fish of course they said yes. I will book with Chad next time we are there for sure.

quotes.name: David K.
quotes.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our trip with Captain Chad. He was knowledgeable, knew where the fish were, and he was fun to hangout with. He went out of his way to make our trip memorable and to meet our goals. We plan to make this an annual trip with Captain Chad.

quotes.name: Cherie L.
quotes.text: We loved Captain Chad! Fabulous experience all around!

quotes.name: Verified guest
quotes.text: Awesome trip! Captain Chad took us out to a great spot and we started catching fish right away. Great day!

quotes.name: Color in the Water
quotes.text: Highly recommend Captain Chad. He took me and my husband and four sons out, and gave us a wonderful first time ocean fishing experience. If you want to experience ocean fishing with an experienced captain, you will be more than pleased. Plenty of poles, constant refresh of fresh bait, helpful tips, and he took us to multiple locations for the best luck possible. He saw how much we loved seeing the dolphins, so he switched things up and we went dolphin "chasing", to see them play and jump. Then he even let my boys take the wheel for a bit so they got to feel like big shots! I couldn't imagine a better experience on the water…thanks Captain Chad for an awesome day!

quotes.name: Brad D.
quotes.text: Trip was Excellent! Knew where fish were and put us on them first thing out of the gate! Would recommend to anyone looking to be exhausted from fighting the catch.

quotes.text: We had a blast out on the water with Reel Deal Fishin Charters! Chad was super patient and helpful the whole time, and we even caught fish! Highly recommend if you're looking for a fun and stress-free fishing trip. Can't wait to book with him again!

quotes.name: Sindos S.
quotes.text: Chad at Reel Deal fishing was amazing. He was knowledgeable and kind to my kids and I during our Florida fishing excursion. He helped us catch all the fish and taught us a lot about fishing in the Atlantic Ocean. Thank you Chad for a wonderful experience.

quotes.text: We had the opportunity to go out with Captain Chad of Reel Deal fishing charters and had an amazing time. Not only did we have fun, but we caught a lot of fish, and fish that we could take home and eat. I highly recommend you book a charter with Captain Chad @ Reel Deal Fishing Charters.
